# Mike Wilson Digital

An AI-first website system, built in the open by Mike Wilson: a starter kit
for shipping fast, production-ready websites with Astro, Cloudflare, and AI.
The site's primary goal is the email list — join for early access to the kit.

## Bio

Mike Wilson — builder shipping fast, production-ready websites with an
AI-first workflow (Astro + Cloudflare + AI), in the open.
